scene.title: Area under y = x from 0 to 2
scene.summary: The integral of y = x from 0 to 2 equals the area of a right triangle with base and height 2, giving 2.

beats.title: Plot the line
beats.narration: We draw the line y = x on the coordinate grid.

beats.title: Mark the interval
beats.narration: Vertical lines at x = 0 and x = 2 bound the region of interest.

beats.title: Shade the area
beats.narration: The area under the line between 0 and 2 forms a right triangle.

beats.title: Label base and height
beats.narration: The triangle’s base and height are both 2 units long.

beats.title: Compute the area
beats.narration: Area = ½·base·height = ½·2·2 = 2, matching the integral result.
